zh-CN.A landing splits one tall staircase into: 楼梯尺寸应从完成后的地面到完成后的地面测量。忽略地板、平台或铺面厚度，会让第一步或最后一步不一致。
zh-CN.Total Rise Still Rules Everything: 平衡踏步高和踏面深度
zh-CN.Even with a landing, the total rise from: 踏步高、踏面深度和总进深共同决定楼梯是否舒适。一个小误差会重复到整段楼梯上，所以需要先算清楚。
zh-CN.Decide how many risers go below the land: 在决定楼梯梁之前，要检查水平空间、洞口、转角、门扇、扶手和净空。能走通的楼梯不一定安装得下。
zh-CN.A landing generally must be at least as: 对复杂现场，先画一根样板楼梯梁并现场核对，再批量切割。一次验证比整批返工便宜得多。
zh-CN.Each Flight Gets Its Own Stringers: Each Flight Gets Its Own Stringers
zh-CN.Below the landing and above the landing: Below the landing and above the landing are effectively two separate stairs, each with its own set of stringers cut to the shared riser height. The landing is framed as a small platform that both flights connect to. So you cut two stringer sets, but both use the identical rise so the climb feels seamless.
zh-CN.Landings and turns are where headroom pr: Landings and turns are where headroom problems hide. As the upper flight passes over the lower, or as a turn brings the ceiling closer, you must keep the minimum headroom along the whole walking path. Check headroom at the landing and at the top of each flight, not just on the straight runs.
zh-CN.Calculate Each Flight, Share The Rise: Calculate Each Flight, Share The Rise
zh-CN.The practical workflow is to set the ris: The practical workflow is to set the riser height for the total rise, then run each flight through a stair calculator using that fixed riser height and the flight's run. The Stringer app lets you keep both flights as saved projects with matching risers, so the landing stair stays consistent and code-aware end to end.
zh-CN.Keep riser height identical above and be: 核对踏步数和每步高度。
zh-CN.Check headroom through the landing and t: Check headroom through the landing and turn.
